request: how many seconds are in a day?

beats.intent: A day bar split into 24 hour blocks
beats.narration: A day has twenty four hours.
beats.code:
stage.title("Seconds in a day")
hours = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=0.45, height=0.8, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4) for _ in range(24)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.02).move_to([0, 1.6, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(h) for h in hours], lag_ratio=0.03))
stage.add(hours)
stage.label(hours, "24 hours", direction=UP, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: One hour block zoomed into 60 minute strips, one minute into 60 second ticks
beats.narration: Each hour has sixty minutes, and each minute sixty seconds.
beats.code:
mins = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=0.11, height=0.6, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5, stroke_width=1) for _ in range(60)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.02).move_to([0, 0.0, 0])
secs = VGroup(*[Line(UP * 0.2, DOWN * 0.2, color=ORANGE) for _ in range(60)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.11).move_to([0, -1.4, 0])
link1 = DashedLine(hours[0].get_bottom(), mins.get_corner(UL), color=GREY_B)
link2 = DashedLine(mins[0].get_bottom(), secs.get_corner(UL), color=GREY_B)
stage.play(Create(link1), FadeIn(mins))
stage.play(Create(link2), FadeIn(secs))
stage.add(link1, link2, mins, secs)
stage.label(mins, "60 minutes", direction=RIGHT, color=GREEN)
stage.label(secs, "60 seconds", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.narration: Multiply: twenty four times sixty times sixty is eighty six thousand four hundred seconds.

request: how do I draw my 4 m by 3 m room at a scale of 1:50?

beats.intent: A 4 m by 3 m room outline with a door gap
beats.narration: The room is four metres by three.
beats.code:
stage.title("A scale drawing")
room = VMobject(color=WHITE, stroke_width=5).set_points_as_corners([[-1.6, -2.0, 0], [-3.6, -2.0, 0], [-3.6, 1.0, 0], [0.4, 1.0, 0], [0.4, -2.0, 0], [-0.8, -2.0, 0]])
stage.play(Create(room))
stage.add(room)
stage.label(Line([-3.6, 1.0, 0], [0.4, 1.0, 0]), "4 m", direction=UP)
stage.label(Line([0.4, 1.0, 0], [0.4, -2.0, 0]), "3 m", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: A small rectangle 8 cm by 6 cm drawn beside it at 1:50
beats.narration: At one to fifty, every metre becomes two centimetres on paper: four hundred centimetres over fifty is eight.
beats.code:
paper = Rectangle(width=1.6, height=1.2, color=YELLOW).move_to([3.6, -0.5, 0])
stage.play(Create(paper))
stage.add(paper)
stage.label(paper, "8 cm", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)
stage.label(paper, "6 cm", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("scale 1 : 50")

beats.intent: The drawings beside 400 cm ÷ 50 = 8 cm and 300 cm ÷ 50 = 6 cm
beats.narration: Three hundred over fifty is six. The drawing is eight centimetres by six.

request: how fast is something going 3 seconds after I drop it?

beats.intent: Axes of time and speed with the line v = 10t
beats.narration: A dropped stone speeds up by about ten metres a second, every second.
beats.code:
stage.title("Falling speed")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 4), y_range=(0, 40), labels=("seconds", "m/s"))
g = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 10 * t, color=ORANGE)

beats.narration: After three seconds it is falling at thirty metres a second, over a hundred kilometres an hour.

beats.intent: The triangle under the line up to t = 3 shaded, beside distance = ½ × 3 × 30 = 45 m
beats.narration: The distance fallen is the area under the line: a triangle, half of three times thirty, forty five metres.
beats.code:
tri = Polygon(ax.c2p(0, 0), ax.c2p(3, 0), ax.c2p(3, 30), stroke_width=0, fill_color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.35)
stage.play(FadeIn(tri))
stage.add(tri)
stage.equation(r"\tfrac12 \times 3 \times 30 = 45\ \text{m}")

request: does a heavy ball fall faster than a light one?

beats.intent: A tower with a big ball and a small ball at the top, side by side
beats.narration: Drop a heavy ball and a light ball from a tower at the same moment.
beats.code:
stage.title("Heavy and light")
tower = Rectangle(width=1.2, height=5.2, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to([-3, -0.6, 0])
ground = Line([-5, -3.2, 0], [5, -3.2, 0], color=GREY_B)
heavy = Circle(radius=0.35, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-1.4, 1.7, 0])
light = Circle(radius=0.15, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([0.2, 1.7, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(tower), Create(ground), FadeIn(heavy), FadeIn(light))
stage.add(tower, ground, heavy, light)
stage.label(heavy, "10 kg", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)
stage.label(light, "1 kg", direction=UP, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: Both balls falling together and landing at the same moment
beats.narration: Without air resistance they fall side by side and land together.
beats.code:
stage.play(heavy.animate.move_to([-1.4, -2.85, 0]), light.animate.move_to([0.2, -3.05, 0]), run_time=1.5, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_quad)
stage.caption("they land together")

beats.intent: The picture beside: 10× the weight, but 10× harder to speed up, so a = g for both
beats.narration: The heavy ball is pulled ten times harder, but it is also ten times harder to speed up. The two cancel, so both speed up at the same rate.
